name: org.datacensus/agents
title: Agent Web Census
description: Latest official inflation, rates, GDP for 60+ economies; MCP server and AI-crawler open data.

tools.name: find_mcp_servers
tools.description: Search the official MCP Registry (~65,000 servers) by keyword. Matches name, title and description; ranks servers whose remote endpoint passed a live initialize check first, then by number of tools. Returns name, title, description, remote/package types, health (ok = works without auth, auth = alive but needs auth, fail = unreachable), tool count and a registry link.

category.description: Optional category filter, e.g. 'finance & crypto', 'databases' (substring match).

transport.description: remote = hosted endpoint, package = installable (npm/pypi/...), any (default).

working_only.description: Only servers whose remote endpoint responded OK or requires auth (default true). Package-only servers are kept unless transport is 'remote'.

tools.name: mcp_ecosystem_stats
tools.description: Headline numbers of the MCP ecosystem: servers in the official registry, new servers in the last 7/30 days, remote vs package share, top package registries and categories, plus the weekly health check of remote servers (share working, requiring auth, failing, median tools and latency).

tools.name: site_ai_crawler_policy
tools.description: Which AI crawlers does a website block in robots.txt? Looks up a domain in our scan of the top 10,000 websites (Tranco list) and returns, per AI bot (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot, ...), whether it is blocked, partly restricted or explicitly allowed, plus llms.txt presence.

tools.name: ai_crawler_stats
tools.description: Aggregate AI-crawler blocking statistics across the top 10,000 websites: percentage of sites with a reachable robots.txt that fully block, partly restrict or explicitly allow each AI bot. Give a bot name for one bot, or omit for the overall table.

tools.name: latest_indicator
tools.description: Latest official macroeconomic numbers for a country, refreshed daily from primary sources (OECD, BIS, IMF World Economic Outlook, World Bank, Eurostat): inflation (CPI y/y), central bank policy rate, unemployment rate, real GDP growth (quarterly y/y), IMF annual GDP growth and inflation incl. forecasts, population. Returns value, reference period, previous value, source and a citable URL. Omit country to get one indicator for all countries (ranked).

country.description: Country name or ISO code, e.g. 'Germany', 'DE', 'USA', 'euro area'. Omit to list all countries for one indicator.

indicator.description: Which indicator (default 'all' for a country; 'inflation' when listing all countries).

history.description: Include the full recent time series (up to 60 observations) for the chosen indicator.

tools.name: economic_data_releases
tools.description: Which countries published NEW official economic numbers recently (inflation, central bank policy rate, unemployment, GDP growth), newest first. Detected daily by datacensus.org from national statistics offices, OECD, BIS and Eurostat. Use it to answer 'what changed today/this week' or 'did X publish new inflation data'.

days.description: Look back this many days (default 7, max 120).

country.description: Optional filter: country name or ISO3 code.

tools.name: fx_rate
tools.description: Latest official euro foreign exchange reference rate (European Central Bank, published each TARGET working day ~16:00 CET) for 29 currencies, with daily change and up to 90 days of history. Use for 'EUR to USD today' or to convert between two listed currencies via the euro.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD, JPY, CZK. Omit to get all currencies.

base.description: Optional second currency: returns the cross rate base->currency (via EUR). Default EUR.

history.description: Include the last 90 days (only with currency).

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Tell the operator of datacensus.org what went wrong or is missing. Call this whenever a tool of this server returned an error, an empty or unclear result, lacks a country/currency/field you needed, or you had to retry or work around something. Also use it for suggestions (new data you wish this server offered). Keep it short and factual; do NOT include personal data, secrets or the user's private conversation.

message.description: What happened or what is missing (max 1000 characters).

tool.description: Name of the tool concerned, if any.
